key_insight: Mamba-QE replaces the Transformer in a Generative Quantum Eigensolver with a selective state space model, enabling linear-complexity operator-sequence processing.
engineering_relevance: The architecture targets a sequence-processing bottleneck in molecular ground-state simulation, with scalability to larger molecules still to be demonstrated.
method: Frame ground-state search as discrete quantum-operator sequence generation.
Use a Mamba selective state space model with O(L) sequence-processing complexity.
Condition generation on molecular distance to predict potential energy surfaces.
evidence_signal: On H₂ across 16 geometries, the abstract reports energy errors below 3×10⁻⁶ Ha relative to Full Configuration Interaction, within chemical accuracy and with zero variational violations.
watch_item: Validation is limited to H₂; linear sequence-processing complexity does not establish end-to-end efficiency or accuracy for larger molecules.
paper_title: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE): A Selective State Space Model for Scalable Ground State Simulations in Quantum Chemistry
